name: FinTechCore
description: Financial workflow composition layer. Crypto is Module 01; FT-0 through FT-6A provide research/paper, durable traceability, deterministic risk/compliance and decision-bound OrderIntent/reconciliation controls without productive scoring or real execution authority.

events.note: FinTechCore persists append-only domain/decision/intent/reconciliation evidence through the existing private persistence boundary. Event publication does not create a second EventMesh or queue authority.

implementedAreas: core contracts and immutable module registry
provenance-aware category analysis profiles and feature contracts
detector-agnostic pattern research with non-authorizing evidence
deterministic replayable paper trading with explicit costs
deterministic risk and compliance gates using versioned external policy snapshots
append-only risk/compliance decision evidence with input/output hashes
FT-6A PAPER-only OrderIntent binding derived from approved decision records
decision output-hash, policy, workflow, idempotency, client-order, TTL and order-bound intent fingerprint
typed decision-to-intent reconciliation with tamper mismatch evidence
service-role-only FT-6 persistence migration prepared but not applied
DeFiLlama protocol evidence provider remains evidence-only and outside scoring/order authority
blockedAreas: live acquisition of remaining category-specific evidence
category evidence promotion into canonical scoring without explicit model-contract approval
24-asset crypto universe final availability/evidence admission proof
concrete TA-Lib or other detector runtime binding

authorityBoundary: FinTechCore composes financial workflows and typed evidence but cannot select or calculate productive scores outside ScoringModelRegistry/ScoringDispatcher. CryptoOrchestrator and pattern/agent outputs remain research-only unless separately promoted by existing evidence/model contracts. FT-6A derives OrderIntent approvals only from authoritative append-only FT-5 decisions, remains PAPER-only, asserts no real execution or settlement finality, and cannot replace IAM, Compliance, Quality, Governance, Supervisor, Release or Deployment authorities.
